# Cabana Connect → Solenne Hotels: Proposal Deck (v2)

*Note: this version corrects the figures in John's draft and discloses one RFP gap. Details in the internal note at the end.*

---

### Slide 1: Cabana Connect for Solenne Hotels — summary
- For Jane Doe (COO) and Richard Miles (CFO)
- Scope: 12 properties / 2,160 rooms today, with a path to 14 / ~2,460 by Q2 2027
- Investment: €132,192/yr net subscription; 3-year TCV €414,576
- Return: ~€60k/yr front-desk time freed + ~€624k/yr upsell revenue (pilot-based); payback ≈ 3 months
- One RFP gap (on-premise deployment) with a proposed alternative — slide 4

*Speaker note: Lead with the numbers Richard will check, and raise the compliance gap ourselves.*

---

### Slide 2: Solenne today — the problem
- Front desks handle ~9,000 calls/month × 4 min = 600 staff-hours/month, i.e. €14,400/month (€172,800/yr) at €24/h
- Most calls are basic questions (Wi-Fi, check-out time, directions) that interrupt guests standing at the desk
- No structured upsell process — late check-out, upgrades and F&B go unsold
- Guests increasingly expect WhatsApp; the phone is now the slowest channel for them too

*Speaker note: Confirm the 9,000 figure covers the current 12 hotels before we lean on it.*

---

### Slide 3: The solution — Cabana Connect
- Pre-arrival: automated WhatsApp/SMS with check-in details, FAQs and upsell offers
- In-stay: two-way chat auto-translated across 40 languages, routed to the right team
- Upsells: rule-based offers (late check-out, upgrades, F&B) posted to the folio via native Ostrava PMS integration
- SAML SSO; one tenant across all properties; EU-hosted (Frankfurt), ISO 27001

*Speaker note: Demo the pre-arrival flow — that is where the pilot's upsell revenue came from.*

---

### Slide 4: RFP compliance summary (§4, §6)
- **Meets:** WhatsApp & SMS · Ostrava PMS (native) · 40-language auto-translation · SSO (SAML) · data stored in the EU (Frankfurt) · EUR pricing and 3-year term
- **Does not meet:** "on-premise deployment" — Cabana Connect is cloud-only, multi-tenant
- **Proposed alternative:** EU-only hosting in Frankfurt, ISO 27001 certification, DPA with contractual data-residency commitment, full security review with Solenne IT
- **Ask:** confirm whether the intent is data sovereignty (met) or on-premise control (not met); if the latter is non-negotiable, we are not the right fit

*Speaker note: Say it plainly — a surprise here after signature is worse than losing the deal now.*

---

### Slide 5: Evidence — pilot and benchmarks
- 90-day pilot at one Solenne property: €1.10 upsell revenue per occupied room-night
- Customer benchmark: ~35% of routine calls shift to messaging
- Caveats: one property, one quarter — seasonality and property mix will vary; the deflection benchmark comes from other groups
- Proposal: track both metrics per property from go-live, with quarterly reviews

*Speaker note: Being honest about sample size is what makes slide 6 credible.*

---

### Slide 6: ROI — calculation and assumptions

**A. Front-desk time freed**
9,000 calls × 35% = 3,150 calls/month deflected
3,150 × 4 min = 210 h/month × €24 = €5,040/month → **€60,480/yr**

**B. Upsell revenue**
2,160 rooms × 365 × 72% = 567,648 occupied room-nights/yr
× €1.10 = **€624,413/yr** (gross revenue)

**C. Cost**
Year 1: €132,192 + €18,000 = €150,192 · Years 2–3: €132,192/yr

**D. Payback**
(A + B) ÷ 12 = €57,074/month → €150,192 ÷ €57,074 ≈ **2.6 months** (labour alone: ~2.5 years)

**E. 3-year view**
Benefits ≈ €2.05M vs TCV €414,576

**Assumptions**
- *Customer data:* 9,000 calls, 4 min, €24/h, 72% occupancy, 2,160 rooms
- *Benchmark:* 35% applied to all 9,000 calls; if only a share are "routine", scale A down pro rata
- *Pilot:* €1.10 from one property/90 days; shown as gross revenue, no margin applied — at 50% contribution margin, payback ≈ 4.8 months
- *Judgement:* A is capacity freed, not an automatic headcount reduction

*Speaker note: Walk Richard through D at both margin assumptions; the case holds either way.*

---

### Slide 7: Pricing — 3-year term (EUR, excl. VAT)

| Line | Amount | Method |
|---|---|---|
| List subscription | €155,520/yr | 2,160 rooms × €6.00 × 12 months |
| Volume discount (10%, ≥2,000 rooms) | −€15,552 | 10% × list |
| Multi-year discount (5%, 3-year term) | −€7,776 | 5% × list |
| **Net annual subscription** | **€132,192/yr** | List − 15% (= €5.10/room/month) |
| Implementation (one-time) | €18,000 | 12 properties × €1,500 |
| **3-year total contract value** | **€414,576** | (€132,192 × 3) + €18,000 |

- Discounts are additive on list (10% + 5% = 15%) — the full policy entitlement for this profile
- Expansion: the two Q2 2027 properties (~300 rooms) added at the same €5.10 net rate, pro-rated from go-live (≈ €18,360/yr), plus €1,500 implementation each
- Annual invoicing in advance; rates fixed for the term

*Speaker note: If Richard pushes for 30%, hold at 15% — it is the policy rate and the ROI does not depend on the discount.*

---

### Slide 8: Implementation plan and 14-hotel roadmap
- Weeks 1–2: SSO, Ostrava PMS connection, DPA, security review
- Weeks 3–6: pilot property stays live; remaining 11 in three waves, templates in local languages
- Week 8: all 12 live; quarterly reviews of deflection and upsell per property
- Q2 2027: two new properties onboarded pre-opening at the contracted rate

*Speaker note: Reusing the pilot configuration shortens rollout and de-risks wave one.*

---

### Slide 9: Next steps
- Solenne: confirm whether EU-hosted SaaS satisfies the §4 on-premise requirement (our written response within 5 working days)
- Joint: security review with Solenne IT; validate per-property call baseline
- Cabana Connect: issue order form at the pricing above with the 2027 expansion clause
- Target: decision by [date]; first wave live 4 weeks after signature

*Speaker note: Make the compliance confirmation the gating item — no point negotiating price before it is settled.*

---

## Internal note — John Doe, VP Sales

**Re: Solenne — draft claims and discount**

1. **"€250k labour saving"** — total call-handling cost is €172,800/yr (9,000 × 4 min × €24/h); €250k exceeds 100% deflection. At the 35% benchmark the saving is €60,480/yr. Deck uses that.
2. **"Payback under a month"** — ≈2.6 months including gross pilot upsell revenue; ~2.5 years on labour alone. Deck says "≈3 months".
3. **"Fully meets all RFP requirements"** — false. §4 requires on-premise; we are cloud-only. Deck discloses this and offers an EU-hosted alternative. Overstating it risks the deal and our credibility.
4. **"30% off"** — exceeds my 20% authority and the policy entitlement (10% volume + 5% multi-year = 15%). Priced at 15%: €132,192/yr, TCV €414,576. I recommend no further discount; if a sweetener is needed, lock the 2027 expansion rate instead.

Also: RFP says 12 hotels, Jane says 14 — two open Q2 2027; handled via expansion clause.
